_about: The café's menu, in the order it's shown.
name and tagline appear on the menu; served is what the narrator says when the drink arrives (one is picked at random).
icon is the little picture on the menu, from content/sprites/drinks.txt. cup is one of the 'cups' below.
color is the drink itself; top is its surface: crema, foam, a sheen. Both are #rrggbb.
from and until (24-hour clock, café time) limit when a drink is served; leave both out to serve it all day. until may be after midnight.
cups: sprite is the picture; steam is where steam rises, counted in pixels from the picture's top-left corner.
pace: how a cup is drunk, in minutes. The first sip waits for the drink to cool a little; the cup is empty at finish_minutes; the steam fades by cool_minutes.

drinks.name: Café crème
served: A café crème arrives, its crema still trembling.
Your café crème is set down with a small, polite clink.
A café crème, in the cup with the green band. It smells like a good morning, whatever the hour.

drinks.name: Chocolat chaud
drinks.tagline: thick and dark, almost a dessert
served: A chocolat chaud, so thick the spoon considers standing up on its own.
The big ochre mug arrives, heavy and warm. Chocolat chaud, the old-fashioned kind.

drinks.name: Chai latte
served: A chai latte arrives in a tall glass. Cardamom drifts up to meet you.
Chai latte, with a soft cap of foam and a whisper of cinnamon.

drinks.name: Thé Earl Grey
drinks.tagline: bergamot, in a fine porcelain cup
served: Earl Grey, in the cup with the tiny painted roses. The bergamot gets there first.
A pot of Earl Grey has been steeping somewhere. Your cup arrives just right.

drinks.name: Matcha latte
drinks.tagline: whisked green tea and warm milk
served: A matcha latte, pale green and whisked smooth, in a wide bowl you hold with both hands.
Matcha latte. The foam is so fine it looks like moss after rain.

drinks.name: Vin chaud
drinks.tagline: mulled red wine, orange and cinnamon
served: Vin chaud, in a little glass mug. Orange peel and cinnamon, and the evening settles in.
A vin chaud arrives, a slice of orange riding on the rim.

drinks.name: Tisane verveine
drinks.tagline: lemon verbena, for the late hours
served: A tisane verveine, the color of late sunlight. Something to rest on.
Lemon verbena, steeped and gentle, in a glass cup. The night gets a little softer.
